scenicLandscapes|p0057.why: I used your overview verbatim. On the lifts: the research says you are partly right. The main Val Gardena lifts (Seceda, Alpe di Siusi) run from about 21 or 22 May to 1 or 2 November, so they do NOT close before the end of October; the Tre Cime toll road (a road, not a gondola, and reservation-only) runs from late May to late October or early November depending on snow, and shuts when snow or ice threatens; guides say most other Dolomites lifts and many huts close during October, and almost everything is closed in November until the ski season opens around the first week of December. Seceda's lifts are on booked 30-minute slots in 2026. I rewrote April, May, June to September, October and November with that. I could not find season dates for Sass Pordoi, Lagazuoi or Marmolada, so I made no claim about them. Sources: valgardena.it lift opening times, Seiser Alm and Dolomiti.it pages, val-gardena.net Seceda rules, planetmountain and dolomiti.it for the Tre Cime road. October stays strong because the signature lifts still run; if you want it lower, say so.
